amendment_history.note: الإصدار الأصلي والوحيد المُثبت نصه في هذا المسار (37 مادة، خمسة أبواب) -- تصديقاً على نظام التنفيذ أمام ديوان المظالم بموجب قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم (73) وتاريخ 23/1/1443هـ، ونشر في جريدة أم القرى بتاريخ 3/2/1443هـ. حدد مجلس القضاء الإداري تاريخ العمل بالنظام اعتباراً من 4/2/1445هـ بموجب قراره رقم (16/1444/12) وتاريخ 16/12/1444هـ. بحسب nezams.com (المصدر الثانوي الوحيد المتاح هذه الجولة؛ بوابة هيئة الخبراء (BOE) غير متاحة، وأرشيف Wayback محجوب على مستوى المحتوى في هذه البيئة)، لم يطرأ أي تعديل على مستوى المادة حتى الآن (37 مادة، جميعها بحالة 'اصلية'، دون أي علامة 'معدلة' أو 'ملغاة'). لائحته التنفيذية عُدِّلت مرة واحدة على الأقل (مادة 5/17) لكنها غير مضمنة في هذا المسار.

sections.title_ar: إجراءات التنفيذ ضد الجهات الإدارية ولصالحها

verification_methodology_note:
PRIMARY SOURCE ACCESS: laws.boe.gov.sa's LIVE portal was unreachable this pass
(direct WebFetch requests to https://laws.boe.gov.sa/BoeLaws/Laws/LawDetails/ae1d79bf-3716-4bc5-a85e-ada100c8a870/1
and to the /Viewer/ and /SearchDetails/ variants of the same law ID all returned
HTTP 503 Service Unavailable on two separate attempts; direct curl to the same
host also failed at the TLS/connection layer). archive.org/wayback/available
confirmed exactly ONE Wayback Machine snapshot of the exact BOE LawDetails page
(timestamp 20260215011202, ~15 Feb 2026 -- roughly 5 months before this pass),
but this sandbox's egress policy blocks fetching actual web.archive.org page
CONTENT (both the WebFetch tool and direct curl to web.archive.org/web/... were
refused with "Blocked by egress policy" / an explicit tool-level domain block;
only the lightweight archive.org/wayback/available lookup API -- which returns
JSON metadata, not page content -- was reachable). No CDX wildcard queries were
reachable either. As a result this track could NOT obtain BOE-direct or
Wayback-mirrored full text this pass -- a materially lower verification tier
than this corpus's BOE-Wayback-based tracks (e.g. nazaha).

PRIMARY FULL-TEXT SOURCE USED: nezams.com, a Saudi legal-database aggregator,
fetched by direct curl (200 OK, 411602 bytes). Its "تفاصيل النظام" metadata
table gives: تاريخ النظام 1443/01/27هـ; الاعتماد -- المرسوم الملكي رقم (م/15)
بتاريخ 27/1/1443هـ + قرار مجلس الوزراء رقم (73) بتاريخ 23/1/1443هـ; تاريخ النشر
1443/02/03هـ; النفاذ ساري; التعديلات "لم يجرى عليه تعديل" (no amendment made,
as of the page's own last-modified timestamp 2021-09-17). The page's HTML
structure exposes 37 <li class="subject" id="subject-N"> blocks (N=1..37), each
with an <h4> canonical article-number heading and a .content div holding the
verbatim article body -- parsed programmatically (regex extraction over the raw
HTML), not summarized by a model. The page ALSO reproduces the full enacting
Royal Decree preamble (بعون الله تعالى ... رسمنا بما هو آت: ...) and the
underlying Council of Ministers Resolution No. (73) preamble verbatim, both
captured in this record's preamble_ar / issuing_authority_ar fields.

CROSS-VERIFICATION (secondary, partial -- single full-text aggregator only,
no independent second full-text mirror this pass):
1. Umm Al-Qura official gazette detail page (uqn.gov.sa/details?p=18245)
   independently confirms decree number/date (م/15, 27/1/1443هـ), CoM
   Resolution number/date (73, 23/1/1443هـ), and gazette publication date
   (3/2/1443هـ) -- official primary metadata, though that summary page does
   not reproduce article-level text.
2. A WebSearch query independently returned a verbatim quote of Article 37's
   full text ("يصدر المجلس اللائحة خلال (ثلاثين) يوماً من تاريخ العمل بالنظام،
   على أن تنشر في الجريدة الرسمية، ويعمل بها بعد نشرها.") matching this
   record's Article 37 text exactly, character for character -- one full
   article independently corroborated outside the nezams.com fetch.
3. muhamapp.com (a Saudi legal-explainer blog, fetched independently) discusses
   and paraphrases Articles 2, 4-8, 11-14, 16-17, 20-22, 24-29, 31, and 33;
   spot-checking found no contradiction with this record's text for any of
   those articles.
4. An initial WebSearch AI-generated summary -- drawing on laws.boe.gov.sa's
   own SearchDetails listing page for this exact law ID -- independently
   reproduced the same topic/chapter breakdown as nezams.com's own باب/فصل
   headings (تعريفات؛ إنشاء محكمة أو أكثر؛ التنفيذ الجبري؛ الاعتراض؛ رفع طلب
   التنفيذ وقيده؛ التنفيذ ضد الجهات الإدارية؛ التنفيذ لصالح الجهات الإدارية؛
   إجراءات التنفيذ؛ منازعات التنفيذ؛ الجرائم والعقوبات؛ أحكام ختامية) --
   structural cross-check against BOE's own page, not merely nezams.com.
5. The implementation/effective-date decision (Administrative Judiciary
   Council Decision No. 16/1444/12, dated 16/12/1444هـ, setting the law's
   effective date at 4/2/1445هـ) was independently corroborated by two
   separate fetches (a WebSearch snippet and a direct WebFetch of
   qanoonsa.com/p/499110/), both agreeing verbatim on the decision number,
   date, and effective date -- supporting confidence in this track's
   surrounding decree metadata generally.

VERIFICATION TIER (honest characterization): this track rests on ONE full-text
secondary aggregator (nezams.com) -- not BOE-direct and not a Wayback mirror --
corroborated only partially: one article confirmed fully verbatim independently
(Art. 37), the overall chapter/topic structure confirmed independently via BOE's
own SearchDetails summary, official decree/gazette metadata confirmed via the
Umm Al-Qura gazette page, and ~20 of 37 articles' substance spot-checked without
contradiction via a legal-explainer blog. This is NOT a dual-independent-mirror,
byte-identical tier (contrast the nazaha track's BOE-Wayback-x-FAOLEX tier).
Flagged in known_unresolved_discrepancies as bog_enforcement_single_aggregator_tier
for a follow-up pass once laws.boe.gov.sa or a Wayback snapshot becomes fetchable.

AMENDMENT STATUS: no search result surfaced any repeal/amendment decree
targeting this LAW's own 37 articles; nezams.com's own metadata states
"لم يجرى عليه تعديل" (unamended). By contrast, this law's OWN implementing
regulation (اللائحة التنفيذية لنظام التنفيذ أمام ديوان المظالم) has been
amended at least once: Administrative Judiciary Council Decision No.
(19/1446/عاشراً) dated 29/12/1446هـ amended Regulation Article (5/17) --
a regulation-level amendment, out of scope for this base-law track (the
regulation itself is not ingested this pass; see known_unresolved_discrepancies).

SOURCE-TYPO CORRECTION (disclosed, not silent): nezams.com's own <h4> heading
for Article 35 read "المادة الخامسة الثلاثون" (missing the conjunction و),
inconsistent with the grammatical pattern of every other similarly-formed
ordinal in this law (Arts. 31-34, 36-37 all read "... والثلاثون") and
contradicted by an independent WebSearch snippet quoting "المادة الخامسة
والثلاثون" verbatim for the same article body. This track's number_label_ar
for bog_tnf_art_035 is corrected to "المادة الخامسة والثلاثون" -- a
heading-typo fix only, NOT a legal-text change (the article body text itself
was identical and uncontested across sources). Flagged as
bog_enforcement_art035_label_typo_corrected.

CRITICAL CROSS-TRACK / DISTINCTNESS FINDING: this law (نظام التنفيذ أمام ديوان
المظالم, M/15, 27/1/1443هـ, 37 articles, Board of Grievances / administrative
judiciary enforcement) is CONFIRMED DISTINCT from this corpus's already-ingested
enforcement_law track (نظام التنفيذ, M/53, 13/8/1433هـ, 98 articles, ordinary
judiciary / قاضي التنفيذ في المحاكم العامة). The distinction is not merely
inferred -- it is legislated explicitly: Royal Decree M/15's own clause ثالثاً
carves out an express exception from clause ثانياً of M/53's enacting decree,
directing that execution circuits newly formed under M/15 (not M/53) shall
handle enforcement of quasi-judicial committees' decisions/orders to which an
administrative entity is a party. M/15 Art. 18 and Art. 36 separately
cross-reference "نظام التنفيذ" (i.e. M/53) as a residual-procedure fallback
for matters M/15 does not address -- treating it throughout as a distinct,
separate statute. These are two genuinely different, complementary enforcement
statutes, not duplicate citations of one law.

UNRELATED BUT MATERIAL SIDE-FINDING (out of scope, flagged for awareness only):
during this research a Council of Ministers Resolution No. (746), approving an
entirely NEW ordinary "نظام التنفيذ" (65 articles, replacing M/53) was found --
published in Umm Al-Qura on 1 May 2026, with a stated effective date ~180 days
later (~28 Oct 2026, i.e. NOT YET in force as of this pass, 26 Jul 2026). This
would eventually make this corpus's existing enforcement_law track (M/53)
obsolete once the new law takes effect. This is entirely OUT OF SCOPE for the
present bog_enforcement_law track and was NOT further investigated or acted on;
flagged only so a dedicated future pass can address the enforcement_law track's
looming supersession. See bog_enforcement_crossref_new_ordinary_enforcement_law_2026.

known_unresolved_discrepancies.description: This track's full text rests on a single secondary aggregator (nezams.com), not BOE-direct and not a Wayback mirror -- laws.boe.gov.sa's live portal returned HTTP 503 on two separate attempts this pass, and this sandbox's egress policy blocks fetching actual web.archive.org page content (only the lightweight availability-lookup API was reachable, confirming one snapshot exists at timestamp 20260215011202 but its content could not be retrieved this pass). Partial cross-verification was obtained: Article 37 confirmed fully verbatim via an independent WebSearch snippet; the overall chapter/topic structure confirmed via BOE's own SearchDetails summary; official decree/gazette metadata confirmed via the Umm Al-Qura gazette detail page; ~20 of 37 articles' substance spot-checked without contradiction via muhamapp.com. Recommend a follow-up pass once laws.boe.gov.sa or a Wayback snapshot of this exact law becomes fetchable, to attempt to raise this to a dual-independent-mirror tier.

nezams.com's own <h4> heading for Article 35 read "المادة الخامسة الثلاثون" (missing the conjunction و), inconsistent with the grammatical pattern of every other similarly-formed ordinal in this law (Arts. 31-34, 36-37 all read "... والثلاثون") and contradicted by an independent WebSearch snippet quoting "المادة الخامسة والثلاثون" verbatim for the identical article body. This track's number_label_ar for bog_tnf_art_035 is corrected to "المادة الخامسة والثلاثون" -- a heading-typo fix only; the article's substantive legal text was identical and uncontested across all sources consulted.

This law's own Implementing Regulation (اللائحة التنفيذية لنظام التنفيذ أمام ديوان المظالم, published Umm Al-Qura) is NOT ingested in this pass -- the task scope was the base law only. The Regulation itself has been amended at least once: Administrative Judiciary Council Decision No. (19/1446/عاشراً) dated 29/12/1446هـ amended Regulation Article (5/17), concerning the duration of travel-ban/dealing-ban orders. Flagged as a follow-up candidate; the Regulation reportedly runs to 37 articles per secondary press coverage (alyaum.com), but this was NOT independently verified this pass and must not be assumed correct without its own dedicated verification pass.

UNRELATED SIDE-FINDING, out of scope for this track, flagged only for cross-track awareness. During this research, Council of Ministers Resolution No. (746) dated 26/10/1447هـ was found, approving an entirely NEW ordinary نظام التنفيذ (65 articles) that REPLACES M/53 (the law underlying this corpus's already-ingested enforcement_law track, 98 articles). Published in Umm Al-Qura on 1 May 2026 with a stated effective date approximately 180 days later (~28 Oct 2026 -- i.e. NOT yet in force as of this pass, 26 Jul 2026). This will eventually make the existing enforcement_law track obsolete once the new law takes effect, but was NOT further investigated, verified, or acted on here -- recommend a dedicated future pass to track this transition. This finding does NOT affect bog_enforcement_law's own validity: M/15 (this track) cross-references 'نظام التنفيذ' only in general terms (Arts. 18, 36), not by specific article number, so it is not structurally broken by the ordinary law's pending replacement.

VERIFICATION FINDING (positive, not a problem): this track (نظام التنفيذ أمام ديوان المظالم, M/15, 27/1/1443هـ, 37 articles, Board of Grievances / administrative judiciary) was confirmed DISTINCT from this corpus's already-ingested enforcement_law track (نظام التنفيذ, M/53, 13/8/1433هـ, 98 articles, ordinary judiciary). The distinction is legislated explicitly: M/15's own enacting decree clause ثالثاً carves out an express exception from clause ثانياً of M/53's enacting decree; M/15 Arts. 18 and 36 separately cross-reference M/53 as a residual-procedure fallback. These are two genuinely different, complementary statutes -- not a duplicate citation of one law under two names. No action needed; documented here per the task's explicit verification requirement.
